interests.title: Narcolepsy / EDS research
interests.description: Clinical and mechanistic research on narcolepsy (type 1 and 2), idiopathic hypersomnia, and excessive daytime sleepiness. Orexin/hypocretin biology, orexin agonists in trials, autoimmune hypotheses, diagnostics beyond the MSLT, and how existing stimulants and oxybates actually compare in outcomes. Interested in what the evidence says, not in coping tips.
positive_signals: new mechanistic findings on hypocretin neuron loss
peer-reviewed papers with actual effect sizes
negative_signals: restating a press release with no new data

interests.title: NBIS / Nebius
interests.description: Nebius Group (NASDAQ: NBIS) as a business: GPU capacity and datacenter buildout, cloud contracts and their economics, quarterly results and guidance, the Avride/Toloka/TripleTen segments, and how it is positioned against CoreWeave and the hyperscalers. Both the fundamentals and notable price action.
positive_signals: earnings, guidance, ARR and capacity disclosures
signed customer contracts and their size
analyst initiations or material target changes with reasoning
negative_signals: generic AI-stock roundups that merely list the ticker

interests.title: Technical behavioral psychology / interpersonal dynamics
interests.description: Rigorous work on human behavior and interaction: behavior analysis, social and relational dynamics, status and negotiation, group behavior, and the measurement problems behind all of it. Wants the technical version - mechanisms, methods, effect sizes, replication status - not self-help framing of the same ideas.
positive_signals: well-powered studies with methods worth reading
practitioner writing grounded in specific evidence
cross-disciplinary work (econ, ethology, linguistics) on interaction
negative_signals: pop-psych repackaging of a single famous study
cited findings from the replication-crisis canon presented uncritically
